item.title: fix(workers): complete autonomous cloud desktop startup (#126705)
item.summary: fix(workers): complete autonomous cloud desktop startup (#126705) * fix(gateway): admit recovering workers during startup * fix(gateway): admit recovering nodes during startup * fix(crabbox): bind worker desktop to XFCE session * fix(workers): reuse Git base during workspace transfer large clean/stale worktrees were downloading every tracked file after the verified base pack, crossing transfer authority; selectively checkout desired base-index paths, preserving deletions and symlink confinement. * fix(workers): clone reachable stale workspace commits tip-only origin detection forced published ancestor commits through heavyweight Gateway transfer; the existing exact checkout and manifest verification safely own reachability/fallback. * perf(workers): use blobless origin clones * fix(workers): bundle undici in worker deploy artifact
